name: eazydata
description: eazydata provider plugin for Magpie: an OpenAI-compatible relay (eazydata.org) whose model list is read live from /v1/models and whose allowance is read from the x-quota response headers
author: zZ783

scripts.check: node --check index.mjs && node --check src/index.mjs && node test/all.mjs

summary.en: OpenAI-compatible relay on eazydata.org, with its model list read live from /v1/models and the daily allowance read from the API's own quota headers
summary.zh: eazydata.org 上的 OpenAI 兼容中转，模型列表实时读取 /v1/models，每日额度直接读 API 的配额响应头
